_readme: Deliberate prose registers that do not sit on the 678px measure, adjudicated by a
human on 2026-08-31 when tools/measure.mjs landed. A RATCHET like classes-debt.json:
an entry tolerates a register on named pages (or "*"); any off-measure paragraph
NOT covered fails the gate. Delete an entry when its register retires. Keys are an
element class, an ancestor class, or a bare ancestor tag (e.g. aside).
The registers: steps = sources' numbered replication steps (626, a 52px numeral
inset); gap/tax = sources' gap callouts and taxonomy labels; machine/disclose/vig =
funding-map's card insets; tile = cluster-health's dashboard tiles (rail labels and
718px two-column notes); calib = accountability's calibration cards; aside =
timeline's 436px sidebar cards; pv-method-note/pv-src = the uniform 664 source-box
pv-wrong = the What-we-got-wrong corrections block (plum rule + 18px inset), a shared component from the story-page promotion; its entries are structured corrections, not running prose.
card/blank-list = chain's company-card grid (285px card summaries) and the map-side gap list (375px column); both grid registers, not running prose.
mgrid = chain's two-column methodology grid; its column paragraphs are 307px by layout.

Rail registers (2026-09-01, when the gate learned the rail law): goalrow/lists = accountability's two-column grids; reshead = chain's register-table header, aligned to the 980px table it introduces; foot-licence = the dark footer's licence lines, footer chrome on every page.
